strings.zh: 这里是以口袋竞技的未来{NEWLINE}以及精灵和人类的{CLEAR}无限之力为主题的{SCROLL}「可能性」房间。
strings.en: This is the “Potential” room.{SCROLL}Its theme is the future of the{NEWLINE}Pokéathlon and the limitless power of{CLEAR}Pokémon and people.
strings.notes: US 0142/0 | RV039: omission: the future of the Pokéathlon dropped

strings.zh: 在这之前是{NEWLINE}在所有的比赛中囊获{CLEAR}第１名的纪录,{CLEAR}只有优秀的口袋竞技员{CLEAR}才被允许进入。{SCROLL}请务必打破最高纪录,{NEWLINE}以取得第１名为目标吧！
strings.en: Only the Pokéathletes who have held{NEWLINE}the best record in every event{CLEAR}are allowed here.{SCROLL}Continue your hard work toward{NEWLINE}breaking every record there is.

strings.zh: 前面是「友情」房间,{NEWLINE}请通过吧。
strings.en: Ahead is the “Friendship” room.{NEWLINE}Please go on through.
strings.notes: US 0142/2 | RV039: meaning: the room is ahead, not this one

strings.zh: 你能来到这个房间,{NEWLINE}说明你也是出色的口袋竞技员！{SCROLL}但要成为顶级口袋竞技员的话,{NEWLINE}你要努力的路还长着呐！{SCROLL}让我来教你我珍藏的技艺吧。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You are quite a Pokéathlete to{NEWLINE}come here!{SCROLL}But you still have a long way{NEWLINE}to become the Top Pokéathlete.{SCROLL}Shall I show you some special{NEWLINE}techniques? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 呀,{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}还有什么想要知道的么？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hi, {VAR:0103:0}!{NEWLINE}Do you have anything else{CLEAR}you want to know about? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 呀,{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}还有什么想要知道的么？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hi, {VAR:0103:0}!{NEWLINE}Do you have anything else{CLEAR}you want to know about? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 是哪个项目的比赛？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: About which course? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 想知道关于哪个比赛{NEWLINE}的内容？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Which event would you{NEWLINE}like to know about? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 跨栏中,跳跃的时机是关键！{SCROLL}靠近栏架后再起跳的话,{CLEAR}速度会“唰”地提升哦！{SCROLL}紧贴着栏架起跳,{NEWLINE}是得胜的要领哦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: In Hurdle Dash, the timing of the jump is{NEWLINE}key!{SCROLL}If you jump after getting close to the{NEWLINE}Hurdle, your speed shoots right up!{SCROLL}Jumping right up close to the Hurdle is{NEWLINE}the secret to winning!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0142/8 | RV039: omission: last tip dropped

strings.zh: 抢旗啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}这个比赛不仅可以夺取{NEWLINE}沙滩上的旗子,{CLEAR}也可以从对手那里{CLEAR}夺下旗子哦！{SCROLL}从对手的背后撞过去的话,{NEWLINE}会使其昏厥,{SCROLL}这样就可以从对手那里{NEWLINE}把旗子抢过来啦！{SCROLL}其实这才是这个比赛的精髓！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Pennant Capture...{SCROLL}This event is not only about the{NEWLINE}Pennants on the beach, but also the{CLEAR}ones other Pokémon have collected.{SCROLL}If you bump into them from behind, they{NEWLINE}will be knocked down and your Pokémon{CLEAR}will grab their Pennants.{SCROLL}That’s actually the real essence of{NEWLINE}this event!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0142/9 | RV039: meaning: essence of the event, not the way experts fight

strings.zh: 我想你应该知道,{NEWLINE}在抢位置中{SCROLL}把对手推出圈是关键。{SCROLL}实际上呢,对精灵{NEWLINE}做出指示的瞬间{CLEAR}推搡的力量会增强！{SCROLL}勤快地做出指示的话,{NEWLINE}即使是强大的对手,{CLEAR}也可能会被挤出去呢！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The key is to push other Pokémon out{NEWLINE}of the Circles...which may be obvious.{SCROLL}Actually, your Pokémon can push harder{NEWLINE}if you pick the right moment to tell{CLEAR}them to push.{SCROLL}So you might be able to push back{NEWLINE}powerful Pokémon if you give frequent{CLEAR}instructions to push.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 劈石板,{NEWLINE}可不仅仅是劈开石板那么简单。{SCROLL}在石板上,有着细小的裂缝,{NEWLINE}你发现了吗？{SCROLL}准确地打中裂缝的话,{NEWLINE}刹那间就会粉碎了哇！{SCROLL}如果能连续劈中裂缝,{CLEAR}精灵的情绪会持续高涨,{CLEAR}似乎会爆发出更加巨大的力量！{SCROLL}另外还有一点⋯⋯{NEWLINE}想要替换精灵的时候,{SCROLL}把精灵往上移{NEWLINE}离开场地的话,{CLEAR}可以实现快速替换哦。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Block Smash is not just about smashing.{SCROLL}Did you ever notice that sometimes{NEWLINE}there are small cracks in the Blocks?{SCROLL}Well, if you can hit those cracks, they{NEWLINE}break real fast!{SCROLL}If you can keep hitting the cracks,{NEWLINE}your Pokémon will stay fired up and seem{CLEAR}to unleash even greater power!{SCROLL}One more thing...{SCROLL}When you make them switch, flick your{NEWLINE}Pokémon upwards for a quicker switch.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0142/11 | RV039: meaning: greater power, not potential

strings.zh: 抢飞碟中如何在更后面的位置接到{CLEAR}飞碟是得胜的关键所在！{SCROLL}特别是鸟精灵这样的{NEWLINE}精灵在跳跃过程中{CLEAR}还可以进行移动。{SCROLL}对全是鸟系精灵的队伍来说,{NEWLINE}拿到飞碟真是轻而易举呢。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Disc Catch is about how long you can{NEWLINE}wait until you catch the Discs.{SCROLL}Bird Pokémon can move around in the{NEWLINE}air, so it’ll be easier to catch Discs{CLEAR}if you form a team of bird Pokémon.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 蹦床的话,{NEWLINE}只是盲目地乱跳是不行的。{SCROLL}你看到床上那３只精灵了吗{SCROLL}精灵马上就要起飞了！{SCROLL}⋯⋯但！偶尔,{NEWLINE}一只精灵{CLEAR}掉下时撞到另一只,{CLEAR}撞晕了也就不能飞了呢。{SCROLL}让３只精灵有节奏地{NEWLINE}起跳是得胜的要领！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Lamp Jump isn’t about jumping around{NEWLINE}blindly.{SCROLL}See the three Pokémon on the{NEWLINE}trampoline?{SCROLL}They’re about to take off!{SCROLL}...But! Sometimes one Pokémon comes{NEWLINE}down and bumps into another, and the{CLEAR}dazed one can’t fly anymore.{SCROLL}Getting all three to jump in rhythm is{NEWLINE}the secret to winning!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0142/13 | RV039: omission: clauses dropped by US

strings.zh: 赛跑中{NEWLINE}交替手是相当重要的。{SCROLL}你应该知道,如果精灵累了,{NEWLINE}它们就会擦汗。{SCROLL}一擦汗的话,速度就会慢下来{CLEAR}在擦汗之前,{CLEAR}把候场选手替换上是要点哦！{SCROLL}另外,{NEWLINE}让精灵向后方冲刺以实现替换选手的{CLEAR}目的也是可以的哦！{SCROLL}想要快速替换的时候,{NEWLINE}向后方,冲刺！{CLEAR}这是要领哦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Relay Run requires well-timed switching.{SCROLL}Did you notice that Pokémon start to{NEWLINE}sweat a little when they become tired?{SCROLL}Once they sweat, they slow down, so{NEWLINE}switching in the next runner before{CLEAR}they start to sweat is the key!{SCROLL}You can also switch runners by making{NEWLINE}your Pokémon dash backward!{SCROLL}Want to switch fast? Backward, dash!{NEWLINE}That’s the trick!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 撞人中{NEWLINE}单单撞击的话,要对准{CLEAR}头顶是很难的呢⋯⋯{SCROLL}你知道俯冲推挤么？{CLEAR}我是这么称呼它的⋯⋯{SCROLL}向着对手轻轻地起跳,{CLEAR}移动中也是可以起跳的哦。{SCROLL}往精灵聚集的地方{NEWLINE}使用俯冲推挤的话,{CLEAR}能把它们都弄下去！{SCROLL}
strings.en: In Ring Drop, just tackling makes it{NEWLINE}hard to aim for the top...{SCROLL}Do you know the Dive Push? That’s what{NEWLINE}I call it, anyway...{SCROLL}Jump lightly toward your opponent. You{NEWLINE}can jump while moving, too.{SCROLL}If you Dive Push where Pokémon are{NEWLINE}bunched up, you can knock them all off!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0142/15 | RV039: meaning: 俯冲推挤 = Dive Push; clauses aligned

strings.zh: 扔雪球中{NEWLINE}并不是单单投出的{CLEAR}雪球越多越好就可以了。{SCROLL}把雪球做得很大了吗？{NEWLINE}丢出大雪球的话,{CLEAR}会更容易给对手造成伤害哦！{SCROLL}另外,把雪球挡在自己面前,{NEWLINE}从而保护自身不受伤害的{CLEAR}方法也是可行的哦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Snow Throw isn’t just about throwing as{NEWLINE}many Snowballs as you can.{SCROLL}Are you making your Snowballs big?{NEWLINE}Throwing big Snowballs makes it easier{CLEAR}to damage your opponents!{SCROLL}You can also hold a Snowball in front{NEWLINE}of you to protect yourself from{CLEAR}getting hit!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 足球中{NEWLINE}口袋竞技员的技巧{CLEAR}是十分重要的。{SCROLL}万一变成了眼花缭乱的情况,{SCROLL}最紧要的是冷静下来,{NEWLINE}给精灵做出指示。{SCROLL}也就是所谓的部署。{SCROLL}为了守住球门,{NEWLINE}在球门前放１只精灵。{SCROLL}为了对应各种突发状况,{NEWLINE}在正中间放１只精灵。{SCROLL}为了得分,{NEWLINE}在瞄准的球门前放１只精灵。{SCROLL}这是我的建议哦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: In Goal Roll, the Pokéathlete’s skill is{NEWLINE}very important.{SCROLL}If things ever get dizzyingly hectic,{SCROLL}the most important thing is to calm down{NEWLINE}and give your Pokémon instructions.{SCROLL}In other words, positioning.{SCROLL}Put one Pokémon in front of your Goal{NEWLINE}to defend it.{SCROLL}Put one Pokémon in the middle to handle{NEWLINE}anything that comes up.{SCROLL}Put one Pokémon in front of the Goal{NEWLINE}you’re aiming at to score.{SCROLL}That’s my advice!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0142/17 | RV039: omission: that is my advice dropped; clauses aligned

strings.zh: 以顶级口袋竞技员为目标,{NEWLINE}好好努力吧！
strings.en: I hope you’ll become a Top Pokéathlete.{NEWLINE}Good luck!

strings.zh: 口袋竞技胜利次数达到{NEWLINE}１００次的人,{SCROLL}在此为其创造了新的传说{NEWLINE}的壮举鼓掌。
strings.en: Those who have won at the Pokéathlon{NEWLINE}100 times are commemorated here for{CLEAR}their achievement of creating the new,{CLEAR}legendary record.

strings.zh: 为了纪念在口袋竞技中,{NEWLINE}取得１００次胜利而制作的{SCROLL}量身定做的帅气手机！{SCROLL}在背面还刻着口袋竞技的商标。{CLEAR}真是特别的手机啊。
strings.en: It is a cool Pokégear to commemorate{NEWLINE}your 100th victory in the Pokéathlon.{SCROLL}That is your model!{NEWLINE}It is a special Pokégear with{CLEAR}the Pokéathlon logo in the back.

strings.zh: 在全部的比赛中,{NEWLINE}取得第１名５０次的人,{SCROLL}向所有人展示了压倒性实力{CLEAR}的口袋竞技员{SCROLL}在此为其创造的新的传说鼓掌。
strings.en: Those Pokéathletes who have come in{NEWLINE}first in every event at the Pokéathlon{CLEAR}50 times are commemorated here for{CLEAR}their overwhelming might and the{CLEAR}arrival of a new legend.

strings.zh: 为了纪念在全部的比赛中,{NEWLINE}取得第１名５０次而制作的{SCROLL}量身定做的帅气精灵球！{SCROLL}上面还刻着「巅峰永驻」。
strings.en: It’s an awesome Poké Ball to{NEWLINE}commemorate your 50th victory{CLEAR}in every Pokéathlon event.{SCROLL}It’s your model Poké Ball!{NEWLINE}The engraving reads, “Stay on Top.”

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}{NEWLINE}看到了比赛纪录！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} checked{NEWLINE}the event records.{SCROLL}
